question: Queue item 20261030-1045-expand-crawler-scraper-47c4-u01-q07: add the term result-count to the free_tier.metered_on vocabulary in scripts/dossier/schema.json, meaning an allowance counted per result or record that a query returns, and move crawler-scraper/valyu from request-count and data-apis/visual-crossing from object-count to it?
why: Yes: Valyu documents Search as charged per result returned, priced per source, and not as a flat fee per query, so request-count misstates the basis. Three records carry the same basis under different nearest terms or none: crawler-scraper/valyu (request-count), data-apis/visual-crossing (object-count; queue item 20261030-1250-research-data-apis-35cd-u11-q01 asks for record-count) and crawler-scraper/outscraper (no metered_on; its free_tier.notes says no vocabulary term names a returned record and its per_object_cap says billed per returned record). One new term would serve all three.
